comment: Optional extras for the Actions price job, on top of scripts/universe.json. Accepts this object or a bare JSON array. Put Yahoo tickers in symbols, and Israeli fund/ETF security numbers (מספר נייר) there too, or under funds. The browser cannot write this file (static GitHub Pages). Search already covers the full Funder fund+ETF list in tase_securities.json. NAVs: the 15-minute Action always fetches universe + this file, then any listed fund whose official lastUpdate is newer than prices.json navDate (full backfill on first run). To bump a fund to the front of the queue, add its number here and push, or run the workflow manually. See scripts/FUNDS.md.
